messages:
Raj (AE): Hey team — prepping final POC scope for HelionPay tomorrow. They need SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning (100k users, delta sync), RBAC across org/teams, and domain controls for tenant isolation. Any blockers on our side?

Emily (SE): Quick yes — SAML: they require group claims with nested groups and persistent NameID. We support group attributes via attribute statements but nested groups need mapping on our side.

Marta (Sales-Eng): What about SCIM rate limits? They want initial bulk + continuous delta every 5m.

Sam (Infra): Bulk import ok via our batch SCIM job; we'll need to bump throttling. Current recommended delta polling is 1m with incremental patch/Changes API; 5m continuous is fine. For 100k users we'll use streaming + chunked writes.

Olivia (CS): Customer also asking for domain proof process — they want to auto-verify subdomains for tenant onboarding. We require DNS TXT record; can confirm flow and sample value.

Emily (SE): SAML snippet for attribute mapping:
```xml
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name="groups">
    <AttributeValue>{group_list}</AttributeValue>
  </Attribute>
</AttributeStatement>
```
We can map to RBAC roles via claims -> role mapping in Console.

Raj (AE): Pricing question — if they want Dedicated capacity for sustained 400 RPS with 95th percentile latency SLA, how do we quote? Also SCIM bulk run costs?

Marta (Sales-Eng): Ballpark: Dedicated reserve + p50 throughput tier. I'll spin up a draft quote. Bulk SCIM import is a one-time data-transfer + incremental sync ops — include an onboarding fee.

Security (SecTeam): Security questionnaire items flagged:
- KMS/HSM integration for key custody
- SCIM over mTLS
- SAML assertions signed and encrypted
- SOC2 Type II evidence for infra
We can provide an addendum and SOC2 report.

Sam (Infra): For KMS we support customer-managed keys via our KMS connector (AWS KMS, GCP CMEK). For SCIM mTLS we'll need their client cert; we support mTLS endpoints. Also note: for large bulk imports we recommend a maintenance window and background indexing to avoid latency spikes.

Olivia (CS): Sample domain TXT proof: add record _redwood-verify.helionpay IN TXT "redwood=sha256:2b7e151628aed2a6abf7158809cf4f3c" — our verifier picks it up via DNS. We'll send copy/paste instructions.

Emily (SE): RBAC mapping details: customers can map SAML group claim -> role identifier in Console. For nested groups we can either flatten server-side or support path-like claims (e.g., finance/payroll). Need to confirm which approach HelionPay prefers.

Raj (AE): Action items: (1) Emily to confirm nested group behavior and example mapping (2) Sam to validate SCIM throughput numbers and onboarding window (3) Marta to prepare quote + onboarding fee (4) Security to draft answers for the questionnaire and confirm SOC2 delivery timeline. Meeting 11:00 PT tomorrow? :calendar:

Marta (Sales-Eng): 11:00 PT works for me. I'll attach a draft quote beforehand.

Raj (AE): Perfect — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
